title: OT: Grouped Claroty alerts - S7 activity from KPP-ENG-WS01 to KPP-PLC-T2 (Karins Power Plant)
description:
## Grouped Claroty CTD alert (suppressed duplicates)

**Alert names:** S7 Unauthorized Read/Scan; PLC Program Download Detected
**Destination asset:** KPP-PLC-T2 (10.20.4.12), Siemens S7-1500 PLC, Turbine 2 governor control, Level 1 Control Network (Purdue L1), criticality Critical
**Source asset:** KPP-ENG-WS01 (10.20.3.21), engineering workstation (TIA Portal), owner Control Systems Eng., known_good = true
**Site:** Karins Power Plant (Purdhoe Valley substation complex)

### MITRE ATT&CK for ICS
- T0843 Program Download (PLC Program Download Detected)
- T0846 Remote System Discovery (S7 Unauthorized Read/Scan)

### Firewall context
FortiGate FGT-KPP-OT01 allowed the traffic under policy `ENG-to-PLC-S7` (same rule on every repeated alert).

### Known-good context
- Source workstation is flagged known_good in the asset inventory (ot-assets).
- Scheduled maintenance window: Monday 08:00-10:00 Europe/Helsinki.
- Endpoint telemetry shows an authorised engineer logon on KPP-ENG-WS01 followed by the TIA Portal process.

### Assessment
Suspected false positive: expected engineering activity during the scheduled maintenance window. Human review required (NIS2 human-in-the-loop): confirm in the Asset and Firewall Context dashboard, add an analyst note, then close the case as a false positive.

_Synthetic demo data._
